subject: Learning Methods
title: REM Sleep and Insight
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: REM Sleep and Insight.

hook.text: Kekule dreamed of a snake biting its tail and realized benzene had a ring structure. REM sleep connects distant ideas.

buildup.text: REM Sleep and Insight sets up the method, the mechanism, and the learning tradeoff.

discovery.text: During REM, the brain tests novel connections between recently learned and older memories.

twist.text: REM increases in the final hours of sleep. People who wake early on alarm miss the most creative phase of the cycle.

climax.text: If you are working on a complex problem, sleep on it. REM will test combinations your waking mind would never consider.

punchline.text: REM connects the dots. Sleep on hard problems. Literally.

quiz.question: Why does REM sleep promote insight and creative connections?
options: The brain is fully shut down allowing neurons to reset
The prefrontal cortex is quiet, allowing unusual associations to form
REM activates memory deletion, removing incorrect ideas
